title: Proper scalar comparisons commute with inverse proper composition
statement: Let R,S be compatible pro-etale ring-sheaf coefficient systems and a:R→S a change [def-pur-integral-compact-support-coefficient-data, def-sp-coefficient-mate-comparisons]. For scheme maps h:U→V, k:V→W, g:U→W with w:h≫k=g and the canonical composite-coefficient equalities hR,hS, define qR = geometricPushComposition R h k hR followed by equality transport along w, and similarly qS [def-sf-integral-refinement-normalization-data]. For every unbounded derived R_U-module M, T_W(qR inverse at M) followed by properComparison(a,k) at Rh_*M followed by Rk_* over S of properComparison(a,h) at M equals properComparison(a,g) at M followed by qS inverse at T_U M. No properness, noetherianity, absolute separatedness or boundedness hypothesis is required.

source.place: Tags 03DI, 0D6D and 07A6: inverse image, change of coefficients and adjunction mates; Zheng Section 5, 5.13--5.15.

proof.text: Eliminate w. Invert the component isomorphism equation scalarPull_geometric_composition; this gives the compatibility square for inverse scalarPull and the forward pullback compositors.

The proved generic geometric_scalar_mate identifies the geometric mate of scalarPull inverse with properComparison, by injectivity of the geometric Hom adjunction and its counit equation. Apply mateEquiv_whiskerTop_conjugateEquiv to the square, and mateEquiv_hcomp to its pasted side. The conjugates are geometricPushComposition by definition. Evaluate at M and cancel the two proper compositors to obtain their inverse formula.

lean.statement:
theorem properComparison_inverse_composition
    {R S : Coefficients.{u}} (a : Change R S)
    {U V W : Scheme.{u}} (h : U ⟶ V) (k : V ⟶ W) (g : U ⟶ W)
    (w : h ≫ k = g)
    (hR : R.pull (h ≫ k) = proEtaleRingCompositeCoefficients h k
      (R.ring W) (R.ring V) (R.ring U) (R.pull k) (R.pull h))
    (hS : S.pull (h ≫ k) = proEtaleRingCompositeCoefficients h k
      (S.ring W) (S.ring V) (S.ring U) (S.pull k) (S.pull h))
    (M : DerivedCategory (pbcModules U (R.ring U))) :
    let qR : push R h ⋙ push R k ≅ push R g :=
      geometricPushComposition R h k hR ≪≫
      eqToIso (congrArg (fun v ↦ push R v) w)
    let qS : push S h ⋙ push S k ≅ push S g :=
      geometricPushComposition S h k hS ≪≫
      eqToIso (congrArg (fun v ↦ push S v) w)
    (pbcDerivedExtend (a.map W)).map (qR.inv.app M) ≫
        (properComparison a k).app ((push R h).obj M) ≫
        (push S k).map ((properComparison a h).app M) =
      (properComparison a g).app M ≫
        qS.inv.app ((pbcDerivedExtend (a.map U)).obj M)
